eval: (() => { const ks = []; for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) { const k = localStorage.key(i); if (k && k.startsWith('dao-')) ks.push(k); } ks.forEach(k => localStorage.removeItem(k)); location.reload(); return 'cleared'; })()

(async () => { const m = await import('./js/talents.js?v=dao6'); window.__tal = m; const p = window.__dao; p.setStage(12); return JSON.stringify({ dao: typeof p, points: m.talentPoints(12), spent: m.spentPoints(), alloc: [...m.allocatedIds()], canB1: m.canAllocate('b1', 12), canF1: m.canAllocate('f1', 12), canQ1: m.canAllocate('q1', 12), canY1: m.canAllocate('y1', 12) }); })()

(() => { document.getElementById('btn-talents').click(); const panelOpen = !document.getElementById('talent-panel')?.hidden; const nodes = document.querySelectorAll('.tnode').length; const b1 = document.querySelector('.tnode[data-id="b1"]'); return JSON.stringify({ panelOpen, nodes, b1Exists: !!b1 }); })()

(() => { const b1 = document.querySelector('.tnode[data-id="b1"]'); const r = b1.getBoundingClientRect(); const cx = r.x + r.width/2, cy = r.y + r.height/2; const opts = { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, clientX: cx, clientY: cy, pointerId: 1, isPrimary: true, button: 0 }; b1.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', opts)); b1.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', opts)); b1.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', opts)); const after = [...window.__tal.allocatedIds()]; return JSON.stringify({ cx, cy, afterClick: after, b1Allocated: after.includes('b1') }); })()

(() => { const click = id => { const el = document.querySelector(`.tnode[data-id="${id}"]`); if (!el) return 'missing:'+id; el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true})); return 'clicked:'+id; }; const r = [click('f1'), click('q1')]; const after = [...window.__tal.allocatedIds()]; return JSON.stringify({ r, after, spent: window.__tal.spentPoints() }); })()
